description: This file defines the ForNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing a 'for' loop node with compilation logic for rendering templates.

classes.name: ForNode
classes.description: Represents a 'for' loop node in Twig templates, handling compilation of loop logic including context management and loop variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ForNode with key and value targets, sequence expression, optional if expression, body, optional else block, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to compile the 'for' loop, managing context, loop variables, and control flow for template rendering.
